newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SAS to launch thrice-weekly Vilnius flight.
newsitem.headline: SAS to launch thrice-weekly Vilnius flight.

text.p: Scandinavian Airlines System (SAS) said on Thursday it will launch thrice-weekly flights between Stockholm and the Lithuanian capital Vilnius from November 4.

SAS already flies daily from Copenhagen to Vilnius and Lithuanian Air flies three times a week from Stockholm to Vilnius. "Demand for a direct flight from Sweden is very big," said SAS's East European head Jan Lundberg.
Lundberg said SAS will increase its flights from Copenhagen to Zagreb from once a week to three times weekly.
SAS said its winter programme would also include a fourth daily flight to Brussels from Stockholm s and extra flights between Stockholm and Oslo, Copenhagen and Helsinki.

SAS faces intensifying competition on its Scandinavian routes, where it has until now dominated. Norwegian carrier Braathens Safe will launch at least six daily flights between Oslo and Stockholm next month.
SAS is half-owned by the governments of Sweden, Denmark and Norway. -- Simon Haydon, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700-1004
